top_signals.title: EU Steps Up Push For More Joint Borrowing to Finance Ukraine
top_signals.summary: The European Commission and some member states are stepping up their efforts to win support for more joint borrowing to secure Ukraine’s financing needs as efforts to make greater use of Russia’s frozen central-bank assets remain bogged down by Belgium.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Treasury Yields Jump as Inflation Fuels Fed Wagers: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Bonds fell and stocks wavered as a faster-than-estimated increase in inflation fueled wagers the Federal Reserve will keep lifting rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
